changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.22
changeSet.comment: Register the data move rdr229-quarantine-origin-id over nexus.chunks (RDR-229 Phase 3 blocking row 13, nexus-p2m1x.22): one INSERT into nexus.data_moves, no policy (nexus.chunks has chunks_gate_probe_owner_read), no row of chunks read or written. chunk_size 5000, sleep_ms 1000, statement_timeout_ms 60000, no on_complete. DATA EFFECT: one row added to the global registry nexus.data_moves; no existing row of any table changes at boot. The registered move, run by the engine after it serves, writes metadata.origin_collection_id on each quarantine chunk that lacks it, from the registry row its origin_collection label resolves to (JSON null where none does); the rollback unregisters it and does not undo a backfill that ran.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO nexus.data_moves (label, template, driving_schema, driving_table, chunk_size, sleep_ms, statement_timeout_ms, verification, on_complete, changeset_id) VALUES ('rdr229-quarantine-origin-id', 'UPDATE <driving_table> SET metadata = COALESCE(t.metadata, ''{}''::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(''origin_collection_id'', (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND cc.name = t.metadata ->> ''origin_collection'' ORDER BY (cc.superseded_by = '''' AND cc.superseded_by_id IS NULL) DESC, cc.collection_id DESC LIMIT 1)) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections q WHERE q.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND q.collection_id = t.collection_id AND q.lifecycle_state = ''quarantine'') AND NOT COALESCE(jsonb_exists(t.metadata, ''origin_collection_id''), false) AND <chunking_clause>', 'nexus', 'chunks', 5000, 1000, 60000, 'SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections q WHERE q.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND q.collection_id = t.collection_id AND q.lifecycle_state = ''quarantine'') AND NOT COALESCE(jsonb_exists(t.metadata, ''origin_collection_id''), false) AND (t.tenant_id = $1 OR $1 IS NULL)', NULL, 'vectors-082-1');
